name: Husband's Phone
source:
You suspect that your family is trying to take the inheritance your father left you. You can't let that happen, so you start investigating your family and friends on your own. But this investigation brings unexpected things.

[From F95Zone]
translation:
你怀疑你的家人试图夺走你父亲留给你的遗产。你不能让这种事发生，所以你开始自己调查你的家人和朋友。但这次调查却带来了意想不到的事情。

[来自F95Zone]
